supervision_artifacts.mask_generation_summary: The public evidence does not assign a generation method because the reported training artifact and a separately summarized mask artifact must not be conflated.
supervision_artifacts.excluded_mask_metadata: Quality fields and generation metadata from the separate mask artifact were not used for claims about the reported training run
supervision_artifacts.motion_target: offline apparent image displacement; not measured fluid velocity

model_accounting.parameter_definition: all trainable scalar values in the two Conv-BN-ReLU-Conv branches; buffers and the parameter-free rotated gradient are excluded
model_accounting.mac_definition: one multiply-accumulate per convolution output element; batch normalization, activations, padding, finite differences, and elementwise scaling are excluded

audit.training_scope: head-only optimizer updates; backbone trainable tensors frozen
audit.claim_scope: paired checkpoint-preservation audit, not a causal estimate of accuracy improvement

release_exclusions: legacy designs and internal experiment variants
